review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads. They disagree with the item about the founding: the English lead says 1925, the Wikidata interval opens in 1920. The interval is left as the item had it and the difference is what a reviewer should settle first.

summary: The Republican Party of the Democratic Left was a party of the First Republic, founded as a breakaway on the left of the Democratic Party and led by José Domingues dos Santos; its members were known as the canhotos. It contested one election only, the legislative election of 8 November 1925 that this atlas holds, where it took about 3.7 per cent of the vote and seven seats, and it lasted about two years.
